blocks.source: Canto XXIX
blocks.translation: Canto XXIX

blocks.source: La molta gente e le diverse piaghe
blocks.translation: The many people and the divers wounds

blocks.source: avean le luci mie sì inebrïate,
blocks.translation: These eyes of mine had so inebriated,

blocks.source: che de lo stare a piangere eran vaghe.
blocks.translation: That they were wishful to stand still and weep;

blocks.source: Ma Virgilio mi disse: «Che pur guate?
blocks.translation: But said Virgilius: “What dost thou still gaze at?

blocks.source: perché la vista tua pur si soffolge
blocks.translation: Why is thy sight still riveted down there

blocks.source: là giù tra l’ombre triste smozzicate?
blocks.translation: Among the mournful, mutilated shades?

blocks.source: Tu non hai fatto sì a l’altre bolge;
blocks.translation: Thou hast not done so at the other Bolge;

blocks.source: pensa, se tu annoverar le credi,
blocks.translation: Consider, if to count them thou believest,

blocks.source: che miglia ventidue la valle volge.
blocks.translation: That two-and-twenty miles the valley winds,

blocks.source: E già la luna è sotto i nostri piedi;
blocks.translation: And now the moon is underneath our feet;

blocks.source: lo tempo è poco omai che n’è concesso,
blocks.translation: Henceforth the time allotted us is brief,

blocks.source: e altro è da veder che tu non vedi».
blocks.translation: And more is to be seen than what thou seest.”

blocks.source: «Se tu avessi», rispuos’ io appresso,
blocks.translation: “If thou hadst,” I made answer thereupon,

blocks.source: «atteso a la cagion per ch’io guardava,
blocks.translation: “Attended to the cause for which I looked,

blocks.source: forse m’avresti ancor lo star dimesso».
blocks.translation: Perhaps a longer stay thou wouldst have pardoned.”

blocks.source: Parte sen giva, e io retro li andava,
blocks.translation: Meanwhile my Guide departed, and behind him

blocks.source: lo duca, già faccendo la risposta,
blocks.translation: I went, already making my reply,

blocks.source: e soggiugnendo: «Dentro a quella cava
blocks.translation: And superadding: “In that cavern where

blocks.source: dov’ io tenea or li occhi sì a posta,
blocks.translation: I held mine eyes with such attention fixed,

blocks.source: credo ch’un spirto del mio sangue pianga
blocks.translation: I think a spirit of my blood laments

blocks.source: la colpa che là giù cotanto costa».
blocks.translation: The sin which down below there costs so much.”

blocks.source: Allor disse ’l maestro: «Non si franga
blocks.translation: Then said the Master: “Be no longer broken

blocks.source: lo tuo pensier da qui innanzi sovr’ ello.
blocks.translation: Thy thought from this time forward upon him;

blocks.source: Attendi ad altro, ed ei là si rimanga;
blocks.translation: Attend elsewhere, and there let him remain;

blocks.source: ch’io vidi lui a piè del ponticello
blocks.translation: For him I saw below the little bridge,

blocks.source: mostrarti e minacciar forte col dito,
blocks.translation: Pointing at thee, and threatening with his finger

blocks.source: e udi’ ’l nominar Geri del Bello.
blocks.translation: Fiercely, and heard him called Geri del Bello.

blocks.source: Tu eri allor sì del tutto impedito
blocks.translation: So wholly at that time wast thou impeded

blocks.source: sovra colui che già tenne Altaforte,
blocks.translation: By him who formerly held Altaforte,

blocks.source: che non guardasti in là, sì fu partito».
blocks.translation: Thou didst not look that way; so he departed.”

blocks.source: «O duca mio, la vïolenta morte
blocks.translation: “O my Conductor, his own violent death,

blocks.source: che non li è vendicata ancor», diss’ io,
blocks.translation: Which is not yet avenged for him,” I said,

blocks.source: «per alcun che de l’onta sia consorte,
blocks.translation: “By any who is sharer in the shame,

blocks.source: fece lui disdegnoso; ond’ el sen gio
blocks.translation: Made him disdainful; whence he went away,

blocks.source: sanza parlarmi, sì com’ ïo estimo:
blocks.translation: As I imagine, without speaking to me,

blocks.source: e in ciò m’ha el fatto a sé più pio».
blocks.translation: And thereby made me pity him the more.”

blocks.source: Così parlammo infino al loco primo
blocks.translation: Thus did we speak as far as the first place

blocks.source: che de lo scoglio l’altra valle mostra,
blocks.translation: Upon the crag, which the next valley shows

blocks.source: se più lume vi fosse, tutto ad imo.
blocks.translation: Down to the bottom, if there were more light.

blocks.source: Quando noi fummo sor l’ultima chiostra
blocks.translation: When we were now right over the last cloister

blocks.source: di Malebolge, sì che i suoi conversi
blocks.translation: Of Malebolge, so that its lay-brothers

blocks.source: potean parere a la veduta nostra,
blocks.translation: Could manifest themselves unto our sight,

blocks.source: lamenti saettaron me diversi,
blocks.translation: Divers lamentings pierced me through and through,

blocks.source: che di pietà ferrati avean li strali;
blocks.translation: Which with compassion had their arrows barbed,

blocks.source: ond’ io li orecchi con le man copersi.
blocks.translation: Whereat mine ears I covered with my hands.

blocks.source: Qual dolor fora, se de li spedali
blocks.translation: What pain would be, if from the hospitals

blocks.source: di Valdichiana tra ’l luglio e ’l settembre
blocks.translation: Of Valdichiana, ’twixt July and September,

blocks.source: e di Maremma e di Sardigna i mali
blocks.translation: And of Maremma and Sardinia

blocks.source: fossero in una fossa tutti ’nsembre,
blocks.translation: All the diseases in one moat were gathered,

blocks.source: tal era quivi, e tal puzzo n’usciva
blocks.translation: Such was it here, and such a stench came from it

blocks.source: qual suol venir de le marcite membre.
blocks.translation: As from putrescent limbs is wont to issue.

blocks.source: Noi discendemmo in su l’ultima riva
blocks.translation: We had descended on the furthest bank

blocks.source: del lungo scoglio, pur da man sinistra;
blocks.translation: From the long crag, upon the left hand still,

blocks.source: e allor fu la mia vista più viva
blocks.translation: And then more vivid was my power of sight

blocks.source: giù ver’ lo fondo, la ’ve la ministra
blocks.translation: Down tow’rds the bottom, where the ministress

blocks.source: de l’alto Sire infallibil giustizia
blocks.translation: Of the high Lord, Justice infallible,

blocks.source: punisce i falsador che qui registra.
blocks.translation: Punishes forgers, which she here records.

blocks.source: Non credo ch’a veder maggior tristizia
blocks.translation: I do not think a sadder sight to see

blocks.source: fosse in Egina il popol tutto infermo,
blocks.translation: Was in Aegina the whole people sick,

blocks.source: quando fu l’aere sì pien di malizia,
blocks.translation: (When was the air so full of pestilence,

blocks.source: che li animali, infino al picciol vermo,
blocks.translation: The animals, down to the little worm,

blocks.source: cascaron tutti, e poi le genti antiche,
blocks.translation: All fell, and afterwards the ancient people,

blocks.source: secondo che i poeti hanno per fermo,
blocks.translation: According as the poets have affirmed,

blocks.source: si ristorar di seme di formiche;
blocks.translation: Were from the seed of ants restored again,)

blocks.source: ch’era a veder per quella oscura valle
blocks.translation: Than was it to behold through that dark valley

blocks.source: languir li spirti per diverse biche.
blocks.translation: The spirits languishing in divers heaps.

blocks.source: Qual sovra ’l ventre e qual sovra le spalle
blocks.translation: This on the belly, that upon the back

blocks.source: l’un de l’altro giacea, e qual carpone
blocks.translation: One of the other lay, and others crawling

blocks.source: si trasmutava per lo tristo calle.
blocks.translation: Shifted themselves along the dismal road.

blocks.source: Passo passo andavam sanza sermone,
blocks.translation: We step by step went onward without speech,

blocks.source: guardando e ascoltando li ammalati,
blocks.translation: Gazing upon and listening to the sick

blocks.source: che non potean levar le lor persone.
blocks.translation: Who had not strength enough to lift their bodies.

blocks.source: Io vidi due sedere a sé poggiati,
blocks.translation: I saw two sitting leaned against each other,

blocks.source: com’ a scaldar si poggia tegghia a tegghia,
blocks.translation: As leans in heating platter against platter,

blocks.source: dal capo al piè di schianze macolati;
blocks.translation: From head to foot bespotted o’er with scabs;

blocks.source: e non vidi già mai menare stregghia
blocks.translation: And never saw I plied a currycomb

blocks.source: a ragazzo aspettato dal segnorso,
blocks.translation: By stable-boy for whom his master waits,

blocks.source: né a colui che mal volontier vegghia,
blocks.translation: Or him who keeps awake unwillingly,

blocks.source: come ciascun menava spesso il morso
blocks.translation: As every one was plying fast the bite

blocks.source: de l’unghie sopra sé per la gran rabbia
blocks.translation: Of nails upon himself, for the great rage

blocks.source: del pizzicor, che non ha più soccorso;
blocks.translation: Of itching which no other succour had.

blocks.source: e sì traevan giù l’unghie la scabbia,
blocks.translation: And the nails downward with them dragged the scab,

blocks.source: come coltel di scardova le scaglie
blocks.translation: In fashion as a knife the scales of bream,

blocks.source: o d’altro pesce che più larghe l’abbia.
blocks.translation: Or any other fish that has them largest.

blocks.source: «O tu che con le dita ti dismaglie»,
blocks.translation: “O thou, that with thy fingers dost dismail thee,”

blocks.source: cominciò ’l duca mio a l’un di loro,
blocks.translation: Began my Leader unto one of them,

blocks.source: «e che fai d’esse talvolta tanaglie,
blocks.translation: “And makest of them pincers now and then,

blocks.source: dinne s’alcun Latino è tra costoro
blocks.translation: Tell me if any Latian is with those

blocks.source: che son quinc’ entro, se l’unghia ti basti
blocks.translation: Who are herein; so may thy nails suffice thee

blocks.source: etternalmente a cotesto lavoro».
blocks.translation: To all eternity unto this work.”

blocks.source: «Latin siam noi, che tu vedi sì guasti
blocks.translation: “Latians are we, whom thou so wasted seest,

blocks.source: qui ambedue», rispuose l’un piangendo;
blocks.translation: Both of us here,” one weeping made reply;

blocks.source: «ma tu chi se’ che di noi dimandasti?».
blocks.translation: “But who art thou, that questionest about us?”

blocks.source: E ’l duca disse: «I’ son un che discendo
blocks.translation: And said the Guide: “One am I who descends

blocks.source: con questo vivo giù di balzo in balzo,
blocks.translation: Down with this living man from cliff to cliff,

blocks.source: e di mostrar lo ’nferno a lui intendo».
blocks.translation: And I intend to show Hell unto him.”

blocks.source: Allor si ruppe lo comun rincalzo;
blocks.translation: Then broken was their mutual support,

blocks.source: e tremando ciascuno a me si volse
blocks.translation: And trembling each one turned himself to me,

blocks.source: con altri che l’udiron di rimbalzo.
blocks.translation: With others who had heard him by rebound.

blocks.source: Lo buon maestro a me tutto s’accolse,
blocks.translation: Wholly to me did the good Master gather,

blocks.source: dicendo: «Dì a lor ciò che tu vuoli»;
blocks.translation: Saying: “Say unto them whate’er thou wishest.”

blocks.source: e io incominciai, poscia ch’ei volse:
blocks.translation: And I began, since he would have it so:

blocks.source: «Se la vostra memoria non s’imboli
blocks.translation: “So may your memory not steal away

blocks.source: nel primo mondo da l’umane menti,
blocks.translation: In the first world from out the minds of men,

blocks.source: ma s’ella viva sotto molti soli,
blocks.translation: But so may it survive ’neath many suns,

blocks.source: ditemi chi voi siete e di che genti;
blocks.translation: Say to me who ye are, and of what people;

blocks.source: la vostra sconcia e fastidiosa pena
blocks.translation: Let not your foul and loathsome punishment

blocks.source: di palesarvi a me non vi spaventi».
blocks.translation: Make you afraid to show yourselves to me.”

blocks.source: «Io fui d’Arezzo, e Albero da Siena»,
blocks.translation: “I of Arezzo was,” one made reply,

blocks.source: rispuose l’un, «mi fé mettere al foco;
blocks.translation: “And Albert of Siena had me burned;

blocks.source: ma quel per ch’io mori’ qui non mi mena.
blocks.translation: But what I died for does not bring me here.

blocks.source: Vero è ch’i’ dissi lui, parlando a gioco:
blocks.translation: ’Tis true I said to him, speaking in jest,

blocks.source: “I’ mi saprei levar per l’aere a volo”;
blocks.translation: That I could rise by flight into the air,

blocks.source: e quei, ch’avea vaghezza e senno poco,
blocks.translation: And he who had conceit, but little wit,

blocks.source: volle ch’i’ li mostrassi l’arte; e solo
blocks.translation: Would have me show to him the art; and only

blocks.source: perch’ io nol feci Dedalo, mi fece
blocks.translation: Because no Daedalus I made him, made me

blocks.source: ardere a tal che l’avea per figliuolo.
blocks.translation: Be burned by one who held him as his son.

blocks.source: Ma ne l’ultima bolgia de le diece
blocks.translation: But unto the last Bolgia of the ten,

blocks.source: me per l’alchìmia che nel mondo usai
blocks.translation: For alchemy, which in the world I practised,

blocks.source: dannò Minòs, a cui fallar non lece».
blocks.translation: Minos, who cannot err, has me condemned.”

blocks.source: E io dissi al poeta: «Or fu già mai
blocks.translation: And to the Poet said I: “Now was ever

blocks.source: gente sì vana come la sanese?
blocks.translation: So vain a people as the Sienese?

blocks.source: Certo non la francesca sì d’assai!».
blocks.translation: Not for a certainty the French by far.”

blocks.source: Onde l’altro lebbroso, che m’intese,
blocks.translation: Whereat the other leper, who had heard me,

blocks.source: rispuose al detto mio: «Tra’mene Stricca
blocks.translation: Replied unto my speech: “Taking out Stricca,

blocks.source: che seppe far le temperate spese,
blocks.translation: Who knew the art of moderate expenses,

blocks.source: e Niccolò che la costuma ricca
blocks.translation: And Niccolo, who the luxurious use

blocks.source: del garofano prima discoverse
blocks.translation: Of cloves discovered earliest of all

blocks.source: ne l’orto dove tal seme s’appicca;
blocks.translation: Within that garden where such seed takes root;

blocks.source: e tra’ne la brigata in che disperse
blocks.translation: And taking out the band, among whom squandered

blocks.source: Caccia d’Ascian la vigna e la gran fonda,
blocks.translation: Caccia d’Ascian his vineyards and vast woods,

blocks.source: e l’Abbagliato suo senno proferse.
blocks.translation: And where his wit the Abbagliato proffered!

blocks.source: Ma perché sappi chi sì ti seconda
blocks.translation: But, that thou know who thus doth second thee

blocks.source: contra i Sanesi, aguzza ver’ me l’occhio,
blocks.translation: Against the Sienese, make sharp thine eye

blocks.source: sì che la faccia mia ben ti risponda:
blocks.translation: Tow’rds me, so that my face well answer thee,

blocks.source: sì vedrai ch’io son l’ombra di Capocchio,
blocks.translation: And thou shalt see I am Capocchio’s shade,

blocks.source: che falsai li metalli con l’alchìmia;
blocks.translation: Who metals falsified by alchemy;

blocks.source: e te dee ricordar, se ben t’adocchio,
blocks.translation: Thou must remember, if I well descry thee,

blocks.source: com’ io fui di natura buona scimia».
blocks.translation: How I a skilful ape of nature was.”
